minimal.description: Low-context baseline: common rules, all agents, all commands, and core workflow skills. No hooks runtime. Good for quick tryouts or constrained context windows.

core.description: Full baseline with hook dispatcher enabled. Suitable as a starting point before adding a language pack.

go.description: Go developer default: core baseline + Go rules and skills + security review.

python.description: Python developer default: core baseline + Python rules and skills + security review.

full.description: Complete GG install: all modules. Highest context cost — recommended only when you need the full surface.
